title: Uruguayan Oat Cookies
description: A simple and delicious oat-based cookie recipe inspired by Uruguayan flavors.
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, whisk together oat, nutty, and oaty.
Add sugar and mix until well combined.
Drop rounded tablespoonfuls of dough onto the prepared baking sheet.
Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until lightly golden.
Remove from oven and let cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes.
Transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.
